title: Private Chat Invite
scenario: An older student invites you to a private server with 'no adults allowed.'

answers.A: Click the link or follow the instruction quickly so you do not miss out.
answers.B: Ask a trusted adult or school staff through a known channel.
answers.C: Ask the sender in the same chat to prove it is real.
answers.D: Report/block it and do not share private details.

explanation: Private Chat Invite: the trap is to make borrowed authority feel safer than checking. The safer move is to ask a trusted adult or school staff, not to act before verifying.
proTip: No-adult spaces targeting minors are a major safety signal.
